name: Absorption native Great Work API availability on the saved PR87 game

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local selected,first=nil,nil
for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do
 local ok,slots=pcall(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots,owner)
 if ok and #slots>0 then selected=owner;first=slots[1];break end
end
selected=selected or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local ok,core=pcall(A.NativeWorkCapabilities,selected)
local result={SelectedOwner=selected,FirstWork=first,GameplayOK=ok,Gameplay=ok and core or nil,GameplayError=not ok and tostring(core) or nil}
print('[JAC_NATIVE_WORK_CORE_API] '..A.Canonical(result))
return A.Canonical(result)
